question: Which district has more paved road per 1,000 residents in 2025, Coldharbour or Stonecairn, and by how many km per 1,000 residents?

s1.answer:
Stonecairn has more paved road per 1,000 residents:

- Coldharbour: \(598.3 \div 11,407 \times 1,000 = 52.45\) km
- Stonecairn: \(506.8 \div 14,926 \times 1,000 = 33.96\) km
- Difference: \(52.45 - 33.96 = 18.49\) km per 1,000 residents

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 18.49 km per 1,000 residents
